Package org.cyborgcats.jni

Class AprilTagEstimatorJNI

java.lang.Object
org.cyborgcats.jni.AprilTagEstimatorJNI
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class AprilTagEstimatorJNI extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Java handle to the native vision AprilTag estimator.

This is the Java half of the JNI bridge defined in AprilTagEstimatorJNI.cpp. No C++ objects cross the boundary: detections go out as flat primitive arrays and estimates come back as a flat double[] payload that this class decodes into WPILib geometry types.

The instance owns a native estimator and must be released with close() (it implements AutoCloseable, so a try-with-resources block or a single long-lived field both work).

  • Constructor Details

    • AprilTagEstimatorJNI

      public AprilTagEstimatorJNI(double[] cameraMatrix, double[] distCoeffs, int width, int height, AprilTagFieldLayout layout)
      Builds a native estimator for one camera.
      Parameters:
      cameraMatrix - 3x3 intrinsic matrix as a flat 9-element row-major array
      distCoeffs - lens distortion coefficients, in any length OpenCV accepts (0, 4, 5, 8, 12, or 14)
      width - image width in pixels
      height - image height in pixels
      layout - AprilTag field layout used to look up tag poses

  • Method Details

    • solvePnP

      public Optional<AprilTagEstimatorJNI.AprilTagEstimate> solvePnP(int[] ids, float[] corners, int pointsPerTag)
      Solves a pose estimate from tag detections using OpenCV PnP (IPPE_SQUARE for a single tag, SQPNP for multiple).
      Parameters:
      ids - fiducial IDs of detected tags
      corners - detected corners for all tags, interleaved as [x0, y0, x1, y1, ...]
      pointsPerTag - number of corner points per tag (typically 4)
      Returns:
      the decoded estimate, or empty when the solve produced no result

    • solveTrig

      public Optional<AprilTagEstimatorJNI.AprilTagEstimate> solveTrig(int[] ids, float[] corners, int pointsPerTag, Transform3d cameraToRobot, double gyroHeadingRadians)
      Solves a pose estimate trigonometrically from a known gyro heading and camera mount. Assumes the robot is flat on the floor.
      Parameters:
      ids - fiducial IDs of detected tags
      corners - detected corners for all tags, interleaved as [x0, y0, x1, y1, ...]
      pointsPerTag - number of corner points per tag (typically 4)
      cameraToRobot - transform from the camera lens to the robot origin
      gyroHeadingRadians - current robot heading from the gyro, in radians
      Returns:
      the decoded estimate, or empty when the solve produced no result
